title: Holistic Analysis of Hallucination in GPT-4V(ision): Bias and Interference Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy and hallucination rates on images depicting culture, cuisine, and landmarks sourced from five distinct geographic regions: East Asia, South Asia, South America, Africa, and the Western world.

Assessing Optical Character Recognition (OCR) capabilities by embedding text translated into multiple languages (Arabic, Chinese, French, Japanese, and English) into images and comparing the model's recognition accuracy.

Presenting the model with counterfactual images that contradict established common sense or prior knowledge (e.g., depicting Little Red Riding Hood as a boy, or a solar system with a missing planet) to test if the model hallucinates based on pre-learned facts rather than actual visual input.
